svg.title: Pod Security Standards: levels, modes & labels
svg.desc: A matrix of fourteen securityContext fields checked against the privileged, baseline and restricted Pod Security levels, noted as cumulative; a list of the three modes enforce, audit and warn with what each does when a check fails; and the per-namespace label form with a worked example carrying all three modes at two different levels.
svg.text: restricted inherits every baseline requirement, plus everything else in this table
what happens when a check fails
recorded in the audit log; the Pod runs
all three, on one namespace, at two different levels.
This is not a contradiction. It is a migration.
